payload.reason: The evidence provides specific measures taken to ensure the accuracy of the confidence network, including the design of a confidence network that uses multi-layer hidden states and a confidence-based label smoothing approach.

claims.text: A confidence network is designed to predict confidence estimates using multi-layer hidden states of the decoder.
A novel confidence-based label smoothing approach is proposed to adjust labels based on the difficulty of predictions, enhancing confidence estimation.
The confidence network aims to assign low confidence to misclassifications, thereby improving risk detection in neural machine translation.
